confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Yunnan tourist-town pricing; no live listings were checked. Peak-season accommodation and Old Town bar prices are the least certain anchors, and restaurant anchors are more reliable. The FX rate comes from an RBA exchange-rates overview page that appeared in search results; I did not open the page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Dali and other Yunnan tourist old towns, adjusted for Lijiang's July high-season premium and its Old Town bar and hostel concentration. No live price sources were consulted for the anchors.
